staticSemantics.policy: reviewed card semantics are stored directly on each active hint; runtime consumers and the inspector must not derive a second semantic representation

valueHints.policy: valueHints are runtime inputs only through a named key consumer; untyped purpose, priority and quality numbers are redundant with structured roles/effects and are forbidden

runtimeConsumers.policy: fast-advance pairs plus tag/damage enabler and payoff pairs influence opening-line executability
pairs on Corp upgrades are visible semantic placement inputs

strategySupportPairs.policy: all other assignments are review and doctrine evidence only; they do not create action scores or planner anchors

requiredMechanics.policy: requiredMechanics documents implementation and gate requirements; only explicitly listed runtime keys may influence AI decisions

scenarioRefs.policy: scenarioRefs link review and readiness evidence and never influence runtime decisions
